overview.description: Sweet Chariot is a lowball variant of Swingo Poker. Players receive five cards, choose two as hole cards and three as board cards, then use their board cards plus one shared river card and one card from any opponent's board to make their best five-card hand. The lowest hand wins the pot. Played with blinds and pot limit betting.

history.origins: Swingo Poker was invented by Steve Albini in December 2007 and developed by the Alliance-X poker group in Chicago; it is named after a song by Naked Raygun. Sweet Chariot is a lowball variation of Swingo: same structure but the lowest hand wins at showdown.
timeline: Thereafter: Sweet Chariot played as lowball variant of Swingo.
history.evolution: Sweet Chariot inverts Swingo's showdown: lowest hand wins instead of highest, using the same shared-card and borrow-one-opponent-board-card structure.
history.cultural: Developed in Chicago poker circles; reflects home-game variant culture of shared-card poker.

setup.players: Two to eight players; best with five to eight.
setup.equipment: Standard deck, poker chips. Stakes (blinds and pot limit) agreed before play.
setup.dealing: Small blind by player to dealer's left, big blind by the next player (twice small). Dealer shuffles and deals five cards face down to each player. First betting round; then each player chooses two hole cards and three board cards; all expose board cards. Second betting round. Dealer deals one shared river card face up to the centre. Third betting round. Showdown: lowest hand wins.

rules.objective: Win the pot by having the lowest five-card hand at showdown, or by being the last player left after all others fold. Hands are made from two hole cards, three board cards, the river card, and any one card from another player's board.
rules.gameplay: Deal five cards to each player. First betting round (left of big blind). Each player selects two hole cards (hidden) and three board cards (exposed). Second betting round, begun by the player with the highest-ranking board (pairs and trips count; ties broken by suit order clubs low to spades high). Dealer deals one river card face up. Third betting round. Showdown: each player makes the best low hand from seven cards (two hole, three board, river, one from any opponent's board). Lowest hand wins; ties split the pot. A player may not fold if they have already matched the current bet (others may need their board card).
keyRules: Standard 52 cards; no jokers. Blinds and pot limit betting.
Five cards each; two chosen as hole cards, three as board cards (exposed).
One shared river card after second betting round.
Best low hand from seven cards: two hole, three board, river, plus any one card from another player's board.
Lowest hand wins (ace-to-five low ranking). Ace is low; straights and flushes do not count.
Player may not fold when they have already called the current bet.
Board cards must remain visible at showdown even if a player mucks hole cards.

strategy.basic: Aim for five unpaired low cards. Remember opponents can use one of your board cards; avoid exposing cards that complete strong lows for others. Position matters for betting.
strategy.intermediate: Track which board cards help which opponents. Bet to force folds and remove a key board card from the table. Ace-to-five low: wheel (5-4-3-2-A) is the nuts.
strategy.advanced: Strategic folding to deny an opponent the board card they need. Represent strength by betting when your board looks weak. Pot limit amplifies implied odds.
tips: Your board cards are public; assume at least one will be used against you.
Who acts first in second and third rounds is determined by highest board (pairs/trips).
You cannot fold if you have already matched the current bet.

variations.noVariationsReason: Sources describe only the standard lowball form of Sweet Chariot; no regional or rule variations documented for this game.

difficulty.easy: Basic ace-to-five low hand evaluation; simple bet/call/fold; little use of board-card blocking.
difficulty.medium: Evaluates lows correctly; considers which board cards help opponents; basic pot-limit betting.
difficulty.hard: Full seven-card low evaluation; strategic betting to remove key board cards; bluffs and hand-reading.

considerations: Hand is built from seven cards (hole, board, river, one opponent board); AI must evaluate all combinations.
Cannot fold when already having called; engine must enforce no-fold rule.
Ace-to-five low: straights and flushes do not count; wheel is best hand.

phases.label: Deal
phases.notes: Deal 5 cards face down to each player. Blinds posted.

phases.label: First betting round
phases.notes: Begins left of big blind. Continues until all have acted and stakes equal.

phases.label: Choose hole and board cards
phases.notes: Each player selects two hole cards (hidden) and three board cards (to be exposed).

phases.label: Second betting round
phases.notes: Begun by player with highest-ranking board cards. River not yet dealt.

phases.label: Deal river
phases.notes: One shared card dealt face up to centre.

phases.label: Third betting round
phases.notes: Final betting round. Again begun by highest board.

phases.label: Showdown
phases.notes: Reveal hole cards. Each makes best low hand from seven cards (two hole, three board, river, one from any opponent's board). Lowest wins.

ante.description: Small blind and big blind posted before the deal by the two players to dealer's left. Big blind is twice the small blind.
ante.constraints: Only dealer's left posts small blind; next player posts big blind. Amounts agreed as stakes.

deal.description: Deal five cards face down to each player (deal phase); or deal one river card face up to centre (river phase).
deal.constraints: Dealer acts at start of hand and after second betting round.

fold.description: Forfeit the hand and any further action in the current pot. Your board cards are mucked; hole cards hidden.
fold.constraints: Only allowed when there is a bet or raise you have not yet called. You may not fold if you have already matched the current bet (others may need your board card).

check.description: Pass action to next player without putting chips in when no bet to call.
check.constraints: Only when no current bet to call in this round.

call.description: Match the current bet to stay in the hand.
call.constraints: Only when there is a bet to call; pot limit applies.

bet.description: Put chips into the pot. First voluntary bet in a round opens the betting.
bet.constraints: Within pot limit; amount up to current pot size.

raise.description: Increase the current bet. Opponents must call, raise, or fold.
raise.constraints: Must at least match min raise; pot limit applies.

declare.reason: This game has no declare phase.

reveal_hand.description: Show hole cards at showdown. Each player makes best low hand from seven cards: two hole, three board, river, and any one card from another player's board. Lowest hand wins.
reveal_hand.constraints: Required when more than one player remains after final betting round. Board cards must stay visible even if hole cards are mucked.
